_comment: EntraChecks Default Configuration - Modify this file to customize assessment behavior

Html._comment: PR 4 of HTML-Reporting-Consolidation. ReportSet selects the HTML output style: 'Cockpit' (default — one analyst HTML), 'CockpitAndDeepDives' (cockpit + listed deep dives), 'DeepDivesOnly' (no cockpit; listed deep dives only), 'LegacyAll' (pre-PR4 multi-report behavior). DeepDiveDomains restricts which on-demand reports are generated; valid values: SecureScore, DefenderCompliance, AzurePolicy, PurviewCompliance, Delta, PrivilegedIdentity. MaxInitialRows controls the cockpit's Action/Review/Full Findings pagination window.

SOC2._comment: SOC 2 internal readiness assessment. See docs/SOC2-Guide.md. Disabled by default.

AzureReadiness._comment: SOC 2 Azure-readiness depth. Renamed from SOC2.Phase2 in v1.7.0 (old name still works through v1.7.x via the namespace shim, removed in v1.8.0). Safe to leave empty — each check auto-detects.

TypeTwo._comment: SOC 2 Type 2 period coverage (Phase 3). Applies only when invoking the Type 2 report workflow (menu [7]).

ActiveDirectory._comment: On-premises AD assessment module. Disabled by default — opt in by selecting Module [8] / -Modules ActiveDirectory, or invoke via [Y] Hybrid Analysis / -Mode Hybrid to run alongside the cloud checks with correlation. Requires RSAT + a domain-joined Windows host.
ActiveDirectory._pr4aComment: PR 4a config knobs. ParallelDCProbing fans out Group A registry probes across all DCs concurrently (faster in large forests, noisier on failure). Tier0OUDNs marks extra OUs whose computers are treated as Tier 0 by Test-RBCDConfigured (DCs are always Tier 0). AuthorizedPrincipalsExtra extends the Group B allow-list beyond the default six admin groups.
ActiveDirectory._pr4bComment: PR 4b config knobs. DACLReachMaxDepth bounds Test-AuthenticatedUsersDACLReach (1 = direct only, 2 = one-hop indirect, 3 = two-hop). AuditSubcategoryOverrides replaces the default audit-policy baseline for Test-EventAuditPolicy (subcategory name -> SF/S/F). Leave empty to use the default baseline.

ADCS._comment: AD CS ESC1-8 audit. Runs as part of the ActiveDirectory module when an Enterprise CA is detected. ProbeHTTP enables the ESC8 web-enrollment reachability probe (disable in air-gapped or heavily-firewalled environments).

GRC._comment: Central Finding Schema (v2.0) workflow. FindingStatePath points to a local JSON file with per-finding analyst state (Owner / Exception / ReviewStatus / Tags / Links) keyed by FindingId. The file is gitignored by default. Set to empty string to disable state merging.
